headline: Laboratory equipment for 82 schools not delivered
summary: In June 2024 the Ministry signed four contracts, worth K8,654,504.49 in total, to supply laboratory equipment and reagents to 82 schools within 12 to 16 weeks of the advance payment.
paid: Advance payments of K2,169,546.90 were made in August and September 2024.
outcome: A records review and physical check of selected schools in May 2025 found the equipment and reagents 'had not been delivered to all the 82 schools'.

headline: Schools' laboratory gas paid for in full, items missing
summary: On 13 June 2024 the Ministry contracted Mecs Services Limited to supply laboratory gas cylinders, burners and fittings to schools for K918,511.
paid: The supplier received a K229,628 advance in August 2024 and the K688,883 balance on 23 May 2025: the full contract sum.
outcome: A check of selected schools and their delivery records in April 2026 found 1,032 items worth K268,131 not delivered.

ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security (Zambia Correctional Service)
headline: 818 heifers ordered for Kawambwa; 100 arrived
summary: On 15 November 2024 the Zambia Correctional Service engaged three suppliers to deliver 818 yearling heifers to the Chishinga Livestock Breeding Centre in Kawambwa within 4 to 8 weeks, for K10,879,462.
paid: Two suppliers were paid advances totalling K1,826,824.
outcome: As at 31 August 2025 one supplier had delivered 100 of its 273 heifers; the other two had delivered none, five months after the contracts expired. There was no evidence that liquidated damages had been claimed.

ministry: Ministry of Community Development and Social Services
headline: 10,335 bicycles for cash-transfer districts not delivered
summary: On 18 March 2024 the Ministry contracted Raton Freight Zambia Limited to deliver 10,335 bicycles to all 116 districts under the Social Cash Transfer programme by early June 2024, for K13,947,083.
paid: An advance of K3,486,771 was paid on 4 April 2024.
outcome: As at 31 August 2025 no bicycles had been delivered. The Ministry said it had terminated the contract and asked the Attorney General to recover the money; the funds had not been recovered.

ministry: Ministry of Community Development and Social Services
headline: Seed for 62,317 beneficiaries in 25 districts not delivered
summary: On 28 November 2024 the Ministry contracted Trans Seed Zambia Limited to supply rice, bean and sunflower seed to all 116 districts for the rainfed cropping component of the 2024/25 season, for K31,564,860.
paid: The supplier had been paid K9,785,106.
outcome: As at 31 August 2025 the seed had not been delivered. Visits to selected districts found seed costing K12,183,482, meant for 62,317 beneficiaries in 25 districts, not delivered.

headline: Serenje early-childhood centre left unfinished
summary: On 18 April 2023 the Ministry signed a contract with Pozzolana Engineers and Builders Limited for 20 early childhood education hubs, including the Kanona Primary hub at K3,864,753, to be finished within 12 months of site handover.
paid: Payments of K2,268,039 (58.68% of the Kanona contract sum) had been made by 31 December 2025.
outcome: A site visit in May 2026 found the contractor had abandoned the site in 2024; the buildings were roofed but plumbing and electrical work were unfinished. The contract had been extended four times, the last in April 2026.
